item.title: Healthy Hair: A Guide to Getting Full, Shiny, Strong Locks
item.description: In this guide to getting full, shiny, strong locks, you’ll learn to identify signs of healthy and unhealthy hair. Plus, get expert tips for elevating your hair-care routine.

item.title: Does Milk Hydrate Better Than Water?
item.description: Milk provides important nutrients, like protein, calcium, and vitamin D, and can help replace lost electrolytes. Along with water, milk can be part of a healthy hydration plan.

item.title: 4 Ways to Prevent Atherosclerosis
item.description: If you want to prevent the plaque buildup known as atherosclerosis, steps including quitting smoking, having a heart-healthy diet, exercising, and monitoring health markers.

item.title: Chia Seeds Sold by Whole Foods and Amazon Recalled for Salmonella Risk
item.description: Navitas Organic recalled 8 oz. bags of its chia seeds because of potential contamination. Learn more about the affected seeds and what to do if you have them in your pantry.

item.title: Exercise and Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI): Strengthen Your Body, Relax Your Mind
item.description: Discover the cognitive benefits of exercise for those with mild cognitive impairment. Learn how aerobic, strength, and flexibility training reduce stress and boost brain health.

item.title: SGLT2 Inhibitors and IgAN: Can This Diabetes Drug Delay Kidney Decline?
item.description: Explore the potential of SGLT2 inhibitors for IgAN. Learn how these diabetes drugs slow kidney damage progression when added to standard treatment.

item.title: People Who Routinely Delay Bedtime May Be Harming Their Heart Health
item.description: In a new study, regularly delaying bedtime was connected to increased risk of heart disease, especially for women. Here’s what night owls need to know.

item.title: Can GLP-1 Drugs for Obesity and Diabetes Also Treat Other Diseases?
item.description: Researchers are exploring drugs like Ozempic, Mounjaro, and Wegovy to treat or prevent a range of conditions, including cancer and arthritis.

item.title: A Complete Low-Carb Diet Guide for Beginners
item.description: There's no official low-carb diet, though this general eating style may aid weight loss. Here's how it works, and what else to consider.

item.title: Grass-Fed Butter vs. Regular Butter: Which Is Healthier?
item.description: To help you make the best choice at the grocery store, learn key differences between grass-fed and regular butter, including taste, appearance, and nutrition.
